analysis.note: Identical to sim/mc-output-accuracy/experiment.json's mc_analysis: the #164 initial-condition contract (every node at 0, EN low, powering up through the block's own soft-start ramp when the bench's 100us EN edge arrives) rather than an unconstrained ngspice `.op`. Held identical on purpose -- a control that also changed the bench's initial conditions would confound the defect with the bench.

measurements.name: vout_ss
measurements.note: Same measurement and same ratified bound as the nominal campaign (spec/target-spec.md "Output" row, 1.8V +-2%, ratified by issue #1 / DR-006). The window is NOT relaxed for the control -- the whole point is that the same window rejects this deck. Expect `klt sim` to grade this experiment FAIL; that is the intended outcome, not a defect in the harness.
measurements.spice: .meas tran vout_ss avg v(vout) from=2.5m to=3m
